title: Media freedom in Russia - Wikipedia
body: 3 weeks ago - Article 29(5) of the Constitution of Russia states, "The freedom of the mass media shall be guaranteed. Censorship shall be prohibited." The World Report 2009 by Human Rights Watch said that the Russian government controlled over civil society through selective implementation of the law, media restrictions and harassment of activists and human rights defenders. title: How Russia’s Press Freedom has Deteriorated Over the Decades Since Putin Came to Power | FRONTLINE | PBS | Official Site | Documentary Series
body: March 3, 2025 - According to the Committee to Protect Journalists (CPJ)’s data, 43 journalists and media workers have been killed in Russia since Putin came to power in late 1999, at least 25 of them in “direct retaliation” for their reporting.

title: Russia press freedom index 2024 | Statista
body: November 27, 2025 - Reporters Without Borders' press freedom index in Russia in 2024 was recorded at 29.86 points, having decreased compared to the previous year. That corresponded to a deterioration of the media freedom situation, according to the index methodology.

title: Press Freedom in Russia Is at an All-Time Low. So Is Its Journalism Education. - The Moscow Times
body: May 13, 2025 - Russia has continued to see a precipitous decline in press freedom, according to Reporters Without Borders.

title: Russia drops to a record-low position in RSF's World Press Freedom Index, ranking 171st out of 180 countries — The Insider
body: May 2, 2025 - Russia dropped by nine points and took 171st place in the World Press Freedom Index published annually by Reporters Without Borders (RSF).
